messages:
jules.docs: Noticing a drift in the Go quickstart: README uses REDWOOD_TOKEN and a raw http.Post without context or timeout. New users hit long hangs and auth 401s.

peter.sdk: Oof. Our Go client accepts apiKey via REDWOOD_API_KEY and also has built-in retry/backoff. Which curl/snippet did they copy?

jules.docs: From README:```go
package main
import (
  "net/http"
  "os"
)
func main() {
  req, _ := http.NewRequest("POST", "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate", nil)
  req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+os.Getenv("REDWOOD_TOKEN"))
  http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
}
```

amy.onboard: That one caused a user's integration tests to hang during CI. We should: 1) standardize env var to REDWOOD_API_KEY, 2) show proper context with timeout, 3) prefer the official client example that handles retries.

peter.sdk: Agreed. Suggested minimal raw-http example to include in docs:```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 10*time.Second)
defer cancel()
req, _ := http.NewRequestWithContext(ctx, "POST", "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate", bytes.NewBuffer(payload))
req.Header.Set("Authorization", "Bearer "+os.Getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"))
req.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
resp, err := http.DefaultClient.Do(req)
```

peter.sdk: And add a recommended note: "Prefer the official Go client: it implements retries, backoff, and token refresh helpers." We'll keep accepting REDWOOD_TOKEN for one release and log a deprecation warning.

jules.docs: Also found a sample repo Dockerfile in sample-apps/go with a hardcoded placeholder `API_KEY=REPLACE_ME` in the image ENV. Recommend switching to .env.example and removing committed placeholders.

amy.onboard: Users commonly copy that Dockerfile into prod. Can we add a short "never commit keys" blurb and link to git-secrets?

jules.docs: Opened PR #5789 updating Go quickstart to: env var -> REDWOOD_API_KEY, add context+timeout snippet, add official client example, and replace Dockerfile placeholder with .env.example and a "do not commit" note. Preview: https://deploy-preview-docs.redwood.ai/pr-5789

ci-bot: docs-preview: build 11122 passed 00 warnings.

amy.onboard: Can we also add a tiny troubleshooting FAQ entry: "If requests hang, ensure you set a timeout with context and check env var name."

peter.sdk: I'll add the FAQ line in a follow-up patch and a short deprecation notice in SDK logs.

jules.docs: Merged after one wording tweak. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
